mapper.update: UPDATE workspaces SET write_lease_agent_run_id = #{agentRunId}, write_lease_token = #{token}, write_lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{workspaceId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND (write_lease_expires_at IS NULL OR write_lease_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR (write_lease_agent_run_id = #{agentRunId} AND write_lease_token = #{token}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs owner_run WHERE owner_run.id = write_lease_agent_run_id AND owner_run.project_id = #{projectId} AND owner_run.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ))
